name: Duck Breast Karahi (Magret de Canard)
description: French magret de canard sliced and cooked fast in a spiced tomato, ginger and green chilli karahi gravy. Halal, no alcohol, ready in 40 minutes.
keywords: duck breast karahi, halal duck karahi, magret de canard curry, french duck curry, Pakistani fusion
recipeIngredient: 2 halal duck breasts (magret de canard), approximately 300 g each
½ tsp coarsely cracked black pepper
30 g fresh ginger, peeled and cut into thin matchsticks
½ tsp Kashmiri red chilli powder
Small bunch fresh coriander, roughly chopped
1 green chilli, sliced thin on the diagonal

recipeInstructions.name: Score the duck skin
recipeInstructions.text: Cut a crosshatch pattern through the skin and fat of each breast, 1 cm apart, down to but not into the flesh. Season the skin side with half the salt and all the black pepper.

recipeInstructions.name: Render the fat
recipeInstructions.text: Place duck breasts skin-side down in a cold wok or karahi. Turn heat to medium. Render slowly for 8–10 minutes until skin is deep golden and fat has pooled in the pan.

recipeInstructions.name: Sear the flesh side
recipeInstructions.text: Increase heat to medium-high. Flip and sear the flesh side for 90 seconds. Remove duck to a board, leaving all rendered fat in the pan.

recipeInstructions.name: Bloom the spices
recipeInstructions.text: Add cumin seeds to the hot duck fat. After 30 seconds, add coriander powder, Kashmiri chilli, and turmeric. Stir for 20 seconds.

recipeInstructions.name: Build the masala
recipeInstructions.text: Add chopped tomatoes, half the ginger matchsticks, slit green chillies, and salt. Cook on high heat for 10–12 minutes, stirring frequently, until tomatoes collapse and red fat separates at the edges.

recipeInstructions.name: Slice the duck
recipeInstructions.text: Slice each breast at a 45-degree angle into 8 mm pieces. The centre should still be visibly pink.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish duck in the gravy
recipeInstructions.text: Reduce heat to medium. Add duck slices to the masala. Toss to coat and cook for 2–3 minutes, turning once.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish and serve
recipeInstructions.text: Scatter over garam masala, lemon juice, fresh coriander, reserved raw ginger matchsticks, and sliced green chilli. Toss once, taste for salt, and serve immediately.
